channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Joe Lacob | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Joe Lacob from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Mike Dunleavy, Joe Lacob, Jimmy Butler, Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“I've also seen that Mike Dunleavy and Joe Lacob have gotten a lot of criticism for their lack of risk taking over the last few years, playing it for the post-Steph era. And listen, there's always going to be backlash when you're not winning. It happens to everyone. That's just what comes with the territory. But I don't think going to trade for Jimmy Butler would be considered lack of taking risks, especially signing him to a two-year $121 million extension. I don't think that would be considered a lack of taking risk. I also don't believe that trading for Dennis Schroeder, trying to make something happen, is a lack of taking risk.”

Draymond Green on Mike Dunleavy, Joe Lacob, Jimmy Butler, Dennis Schroeder, Jul 28, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on Joe Lacob
item.description:
Draymond Green on the trade deadline

“We all know (Joe Lacob’s) pissed sitting at .500. You’d be a fool to sit back and think everything (is OK). Not with that guy.”

Draymond Green on Joe Lacob, Feb 4, 2025. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Bob Myers on Joe Lacob
item.description:
“I just felt like (owner) Joe (Lacob) hired me to do something. I did it for as long (and) as well as I could. And it came to a point where I realized I did that job in my mind. And it’s time for someone else to take it. There was no part of me that was not happy. It wasn’t like I was unhappy. It was just realizing it was time.”

Bob Myers on Joe Lacob, Mar 6, 2024. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Draymond Green on Joe Lacob
item.description:
“To go do what I know how to do, to do what I’m supposed to do, to live up to the commitment (Joe Lacob) made to me. That was one of the toughest things to deal with (during the suspension). I gave him my word. He gave me his word. He held his up. I’m letting mine down.”

Draymond Green on Joe Lacob, Feb 3, 2024. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Joe Lacob, Peter Guber
item.description:
Johnson said after Shannon Sharpe asked him if he wants to own an NBA team.

“But I’m such a Laker fan, I don’t know if I can do it. … I’ve had four opportunities, and I turned them all down. Joe Lacob and Peter Guber sat down with lunch with me in Santa Monica. ‘We want you to be our partners with the Golden State Warriors.’ I love both men. I just couldn’t do it. I’m a Laker. I love the Lakers.”

Magic Johnson on Joe Lacob, Peter Guber, Oct 24, 2022. Source: Lakers Daily.

item.title: Bob Myers on Joe Lacob, Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Bob Myers on the Oubre news:

“We’re exploring a lot of different things. I’m not saying this because the guy’s 15 feet away from me, but I am so lucky to have an ownership group like ours...(Joe Lacob) wants to win.”

Bob Myers on Joe Lacob, Kelly Oubre, Nov 19, 2020. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Joe Lacob, Peter Guber
item.description:
“The Warriors have such a special thing here. For the next six or seven years they’re going to be championship material, they’re not going to break that up. The Bulls (with Michael Jordan) were broken up too prematurely. (Warriors owners) Joe Lacob and Peter Guber aren’t going to let that happen. Are you kidding? They can afford it. They’re the Warriors, this is the Bay Area, they got a beautiful arena, and money’s no object for this team.”

Klay Thompson on Joe Lacob, Peter Guber, Aug 19, 2018. Source: San Francisco Chronicle.

item.title: Andrew Bogut on Joe Lacob
item.description:
“But no. Doesn’t matter, it wouldn’t change anything. I know for a fact the KD deal was done long before I was traded. The Warriors had never signed a top-flight player. That was one thing that irked (owner Joe Lacob). He had to get it done.”

Andrew Bogut on Joe Lacob, Jun 11, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Joe Lacob
item.description:
Rusty Simmons:Klay Thompson on Joe Lacob's post Game 6 bow:

“You appreciate an engaged owner. I feel like he wants to win just as bad as we do.”

Klay Thompson on Joe Lacob, May 30, 2016. Source: Twitter @Rusty_SFChron.

item.title: Mychal Thompson on Joe Lacob
item.description:
Diamond Leung:Mychal Thompson on Klay:

“Joe Lacob told him last summer 'we're never going to trade you,' but so much for that.”

Mychal Thompson on Joe Lacob, Jun 25, 2014. Source: Twitter @diamond83.

item.title: Jerry West on Joe Lacob
item.description:
“I sent back to them and said that in no way, shape or form am I advising him – period. I believe that if you make an obligation to someone … and my obligation is always to (Warriors owner) Joe (Lacob) and the rest of the Warriors organization, and I have no interest in helping anyone, OK? Anyone except if I can help the Warriors obviously.”

Jerry West on Joe Lacob, Jun 3, 2013. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Rick Barry on Joe Lacob
item.description:
“All of the wonderful accolades being sent to you [the fans], for you to treat this man [Lacob] who is spending his money to do the best that he can to turn this franchise around -- and I know he's going to do it. So give him the respect he deserves.”

Rick Barry on Joe Lacob, Mar 20, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Chris Mullin on Joe Lacob
item.description:
And while his teammates had plenty of assists to Mullin in their careers, none of them can match the home fans who set him up nicely all 13 years of his playing days for the Warriors.

“I am grateful to (owner) Joe Lacob for (tonight), but No. 1, I am grateful to the fans,”

Chris Mullin on Joe Lacob, Mar 19, 2012. Source: San Francisco Chronicle.
